summary: BRØDR. PETTERSEN AS (org. no. 984 052 456) is a private limited company (AS) based in Eigersund, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2001-12-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 43.410 (Takarbeid); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 404 662 and net income was -NOK 6 333. CEO: Egil Ivar Pettersen; board chair: Fridtjov Holm; auditor: IDSØ & RAVNÅS REVISJON AS.
